alerting_rules.name: Kong High Error Rate (5xx)
alerting_rules.description: Fires when the 5xx error rate exceeds 5% of total requests over 5 minutes.

actions.message: Kong 5xx error rate exceeded 5% in the last 5 minutes. Investigate upstream service health.

alerting_rules.name: Authentication Failure Spike
alerting_rules.description: Fires when authentication failures (401) exceed 50 in 5 minutes.

actions.message: Spike in 401 authentication failures detected. Possible brute-force or credential stuffing attack.

alerting_rules.name: Rate Limiting Trigger Spike
alerting_rules.description: Fires when rate-limited requests (429) exceed 100 in 5 minutes.

actions.message: High number of rate-limited requests. Review rate-limiting thresholds or identify abusive clients.

alerting_rules.name: Latency Degradation (P99 > 5s)
alerting_rules.description: Fires when P99 request latency exceeds 5 seconds over 10 minutes.

actions.message: Kong P99 latency exceeded 5s. Check upstream service performance and Kong resource utilization.

alerting_rules.name: Kong Pod Restart
alerting_rules.description: Fires when any Kong pod restarts. May indicate OOM, crash loops, or health check failures.

actions.message: Kong pod restarted. Check pod logs and resource limits.
